events.evidence: Iran begins Operation Martyr Soleimani, launching ballistic missiles at several United States Armed Forces facilities in Iraq, including Al Asad Airbase
U.S. President Donald Trump announces new sanctions against Iran in response to the attack
the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) bans all U.S. commercial flights from operating in airspace over Iraq, Iran, the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman

label.note: Iranian missile retaliation and new U.S. sanctions mark major escalation; regional airspace closures add market/transport risk.
